flux2-klein-4b.note: Local. FLUX.2 klein 4B, distilled to 4 steps. Apache 2.0 weights. Measured on an M2 Max (96 GB): 22 s per 1024 px image at full precision, 31 s with quantize 8 (quantizing costs more than it saves when memory is plentiful), 18 GB peak. First run downloads about 13 GB.

flux2-klein-4b-edit.note: Local. FLUX.2 klein 4B following an instruction on an existing image. Measured on an M2 Max: 47 s per 1024 px edit. Same weights as flux2-klein-4b.

z-image-turbo.note: Local. Z-Image Turbo 6B: strong photorealism. Check the weights' license before commercial use.

qwen-image-edit.note: Local. Qwen-Image-Edit 20B: heavier, slower, better at following complex edits. Apache 2.0.

seedvr2-upscale.note: Local. SeedVR2 3B: adds plausible detail while enlarging, unlike plain resizing.

gemini-image.note: Cloud. Seconds per image. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment; change model to whichever Gemini image model is current.

example-command.note: Template for any other scriptable runner (Draw Things CLI, a ComfyUI script). List its capabilities to enable it.
